tools.title: Tools from {{name}}

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: How omp refers to this server. Letters, numbers and - _ . : work.

form.sseHint: Only if the server's docs say so.
form.headersHint: Sent with every request, e.g. Authorization: Bearer ${API_TOKEN}.
form.requires: This server needs {{bins}} installed on this computer.
form.scopeHint: “All projects” saves it to your omp settings; “This project” saves it to the project's .omp folder.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, - _ . : and single spaces (up to 100 characters).

errors.commandRequired: Enter the command that starts the server.
errors.urlInvalid: The address should start with https:// or http://.

skills.emptyProject: This project has no skills of its own

skills.invalid_other: {{count}} skill files have problems, so omp skips them:

skills.noRegistryInstalls: No skills installed from the registry

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Notes omp keeps between chats so it doesn't start from scratch.
memory.off: Memory is off, so omp doesn't remember anything between chats right now. Turn it on with the memory.backend setting in Advanced. Anything saved earlier is still shown here.
memory.remote: Memories are kept on your Hindsight server ({{url}}). They can't be browsed or deleted from here.
memory.readOnly: omp maintains these memories itself and rewrites them when it tidies up, so they can't be deleted from here.
memory.cantDelete: omp rewrites this one itself when it tidies up its memories, so it can't be deleted here.
memory.empty: omp hasn't saved any memories yet.
memory.more_one: {{count}} more. Search to narrow the list.
memory.more_other: {{count}} more. Search to narrow the list.

forgetOne.title: Forget “{{name}}”?
forgetOne.body: omp won't remember this anymore. This can't be undone.

forgetAll.title: Forget everything?
forgetAll.body: omp will forget the memories it can delete in {{scope}}. This can't be undone.
forgetAll.keeps: Summaries omp maintains itself will stay; they're rebuilt from what's left.

toast.restartHint: Chats that are already open may keep using it until they restart.

usage.title: Usage & limits
usage.subtitle: Provider limits and usage recorded by omp.

limits.title: Plan limits
limits.description: Limits each provider reports for the accounts omp is signed in to. They can include use outside the chats on this computer.
limits.scope: This page lists every account separately. The status bar shows the models of the focused chat and its running helpers, then every other provider it has shown since the window opened, and when a provider has several accounts it shows their combined use.
limits.staleFailed: Couldn't refresh limits. Showing data checked {{age}}.
limits.noneBody: Whether limits appear depends on the provider. omp shows them for sign-ins whose provider reports usage, such as Claude and Codex plans.
limits.thresholds: Near limit appears from 70% used and turns red from 90%. visual-omp sets these warning levels; each provider sets its own limits.
limits.pooled_one: The status bar combines these {{count}} account into one figure.
limits.pooled_other: The status bar combines these {{count}} accounts into one figure.
limits.disabled: omp stopped using this sign-in ({{cause}}). Sign in again to use it.
limits.unavailableBody: omp couldn't get usage for this sign-in.

resets.dialogAccount: This spends one reset saved on {{account}}.
resets.checking: Checking this account's saved resets with omp
resets.listFailed: Couldn't check this account's saved resets.
resets.unreadable: visual-omp couldn't read omp's list of saved resets, so it won't spend one from here. To spend one in omp, type /usage reset in a chat.
resets.unmatched: omp doesn't list exactly one stored sign-in with this account's email and organization, so visual-omp won't choose one. To choose the account in omp, type /usage reset in a chat.
resets.target: omp lists this account as {{label}}, stored sign-in {{target}}.
resets.clears: omp's last report says the next reset clears this account's {{limits}}.
resets.clearsUnknown: omp's report doesn't say which limits the next reset clears; {{provider}} decides.
resets.ompCounts_one: omp reports {{count}} saved reset, {{usable}} usable now.
resets.ompCounts_other: omp reports {{count}} saved resets, {{usable}} usable now.
resets.final: A spent reset can't be returned.
resets.notUsable: omp can't spend a reset on this account now: {{reason}}.
resets.unconfirmed: omp did not confirm whether the reset was spent. Check this account's limits and saved resets before trying again.
resets.notSent: No reset was sent to omp.

limits.resetWasDue: The reset was due {{date}}. omp hasn't reported new figures since.

recorded.title: Recorded usage
recorded.description: Usage from omp's session files on this computer.
recorded.partial_one: Usage is incomplete. {{count}} session file could not be read.
recorded.partial_other: Usage is incomplete. {{count}} session files could not be read.
recorded.costHint: Estimated at public API prices from omp's records. Your provider determines subscription charges.
recorded.empty: No recorded usage in this period
recorded.emptyBody: Chats you run with omp appear here with their token use.

kpi.chats: Chats with at least one model request in this period. Subagents count toward the chat that started them.
kpi.tokens: Input, output, cache read and cache write tokens of every chat and its subagents.

definition.tokens: Tokens and input tokens include cache reads and writes.
definition.subagents: Subagent activity counts toward the chat that started it.
definition.cost: Estimated API cost prices each request at public API rates from omp's records. Your provider's bill and subscription plans set their own charges.
definition.model: Model is the model that handled the most requests in the chat during this period.
definition.time: Generation time is the time omp spent writing replies.
definition.days: Days are local calendar days, and today covers the day so far.
definition.activity: Activity counts each model request, subagents included. A day's shade ranks its requests among the active days shown, from the lightest quarter to the busiest.
definition.limits: Plan limits come from each provider. The period switch applies to recorded usage only.

chart.title: Daily estimated API cost (USD)
chart.label: Daily estimated API cost. Use the arrow keys to move between days.
chart.todayNote: Today's bar covers the day so far.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Model requests omp recorded on this computer each day, in local time.
activity.label: Requests per day. Use the arrow keys to move between days.
activity.legend: Stronger teal marks days with more requests, compared with the other days shown.

projects.title: Estimated API cost by project
projects.description: Each chat's cost, subagents included, counts toward its project.
